authorization: User requested six 300k jobs: ordinary Loop and DiscoLoop each at 2e-4,5e-4,1e-3, reusing existing 1e-4 results, preserving original initialization/data stream and controlling cumulative weight decay. This supersedes the earlier lower-LR proposal.
phase: One already-observed Wang development graph and initialization; controlled learning-rate behavior, not proof of a unique mechanism.
primary: Fixed 300k test_oi answer+generated-EOS accuracy; all seven original panels and complete scheduled curves retained. No choice of best rate/node or success-only subset as a predeclared result.
decay_control: lambda=1e-4*0.1/peak_lr; same zero-first-update warmup2000 and constant schedule thereafter. Match each analytic AdamW multiplier 1-eta_t*lambda and their product; bias/LayerNorm remain zero decay. FP32 factors checked independently.
scope_limits: Exactly six new 300k scientific trajectories (1800000 updates), plus six 32-step engineering runs (192 updates), plus zero-LR capture warmups recorded separately
Existing 1e-4 native foundations reused; never restart completed historical training
No change to architecture, initial tensors, graph/panels, merged epoch stream, dropout seed, answer/EOS supervision, clipping1.0, betas/epsilon, precision or scoring
No LR reduction, retry, new graph/seed, auxiliary loss, KV, longer training or adaptation after a failure
Equal steps and data are not equal FLOPs: DiscoLoop adds approximately 2.05x matrix training computation; report costs separately
Analytic matched multiplicative decay does not imply equal regularization relative to the data-gradient step or equal parameter trajectories
Original 2026-10-12 results retained as history; direct 1e-4 controls use already-audited current-image rebuilds; cross-environment bitwise history not claimed
Single-update norms are measured outside capture at each 1000-step heartbeat; observation cost is included and no RNG or parameter mutation is added
